steps.description: Pre-filter to genes with at least 10 counts in at least 3 samples (the smallest cell size). plan.title: Condition x Time Interaction DE + Pathway Enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the treatment effect differ between t0 and t1 — is an interaction question in a 2x2 factorial design (condition x time, 3 replicates per cell, 12 samples, single batch, raw Salmon gene counts, 12000 genes). We fit DESeq2 with design ~condition*time, test the condition:time interaction coefficient (the formal test of 'does the treatment effect differ by time point'), and report the simple effects (treatment effect at t0, treatment effect at t1) alongside it since the interaction alone does not say whether either simple effect is itself significant. With only 3 replicates per cell, the interaction term (a difference of two differences) has markedly lower power than a main effect at the same n — this is stated explicitly in the report and the significance threshold is not loosened to compensate. Steps: (1) sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes) to check the 4 groups separate as expected and catch outliers/batch surprises despite the profile reporting a single batch; (2) minimal low-count pre-filter, DESeq2 fit with condition*time design and named contrasts (simple effect at reference time level, simple effect at the other time level, interaction contrast), ashr shrinkage (needed because these are contrasts of coefficients, not single coefficients), BH-adjusted independent filtering at alpha 0.05 per contrast; (3) fgsea preranked GSEA per contrast on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (human, staged at /mnt/refs), with Reactome, WikiPathways-human and GO-BP as follow-up collections (all staged); (4) a consolidated report with MA/dispersion diagnostics, p-value histograms, the three-way effect table (simple effect at t0, simple effect at t1, interaction), leading-edge genes for significant pathway sets, and an explicit power caveat for n=3 replicates per cell and for the interaction test specifically. Strandedness is unknown per the profile; since these are counts already quantified by Salmon (not raw fastq), a strandedness re-inference step is not actionable in this plan (no read alignments are available) — this is flagged as a caveat in QC rather than acted on.

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind) PCA + sample distance heatmap + library sizes

DESeq2 design ~condition*time (2x2 factorial with interaction term)
DESeq2 Wald test on interaction coefficient condition:time, plus simple effects at t0 and t1
ashr shrinkage of interaction contrast and simple-effect contrasts
Benjamini-Hochberg with independent filtering, alpha=0.05, within each contrast
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald stat, Hallmark then Reactome/WikiPathways/GO, per contrast
Report with simple effects + interaction contrast, power caveats at n=3, diagnostics
